body:
Implemented timed card events with start time and duration, hourly calendar views, date-plan conversion and event-aware Focus attention. Project folders from the preceding change remain project-only. Milestones remain intact pending the owner’s decision about replacement.

The full local gate, all 13 browser regression suites across documented runs, broad HTTPS smoke and planning gestures pass. Intermittent repeated-run failures and successful isolated checks are recorded in progress/2026-09-26-timed-events.md. The manual application was rebuilt and restarted at its existing remote address with the same data, command epoch and instance identity.

metadata.summary: Timed events implemented and remote app restarted
